values.note: 38 rustic campsites plus the camper cabin on the booking map '1-40' (the DNR page says 40 sites); a 20-site auxiliary overflow area is mapped separately. note: Rustic Michigan DNR campground at Tippy Dam Recreation Area on the Manistee River backwaters near Brethren/Wellston. Most sites are generous and hardwood-shaded, close to the backwaters, with a viewing point over the water; an accessible rustic camper cabin overlooks them. Two boat launches (river and backwaters); salmon in fall, steelhead and sturgeon in spring below the dam. --Claude
summary: DNR page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: $20 rustic (confirmed, 2026 and 2027 on the booking site), no electric (confirmed), vault toilets + hand pump (confirmed), open all year (confirmed), reservable (confirmed) with a year-round reservation season (new). Sites changed 39 -> 38 campsites (plus the cabin; DNR says 40), max rig 40 ft (new: 15 of 38 take 23 ft+, 23 cap at 20 ft), no pull-throughs. Phone 231-848-4880 matches. Booking window, max stay and FCFS not stated (left inherited). Note trimmed of field restatements; Recreation Passport now in fees.note.
